description: A pitch to voltage converter: it measures the pitch of a signal and puts out the matching voltage at 1V per octave, with C4 at 261.63Hz reading as 0V

params.text: Smooths the output voltage, so an unsteady detection moves it less
Moves the output voltage within a single semitone

inputs.text: The signal whose pitch is measured

outputs.text: A copy of the signal at the input, for passing it on
The detected pitch as a voltage, 1V per octave

notes: octave offset shifts the output by whole octaves, -4 to +4, and is set on its own display rather than with a knob
semitone offset shifts the output by semitones, -11 to +11, and is set on its own display rather than with a knob
menu: DETECTION PRECISION ON LOW & SPEED — trades how low the detector looks against the delay that costs, from Detect from 30Hz, delay 70 msecs to Detect from 720Hz, delay 3 msecs
